name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a 4px focus ring with a 2px offset to every interactive element that gets keyboard focus. This keeps the ring clearly visible while reducing overlap with adjacent elements, improving readability for users who rely on keyboard navigation. The trade-off is slightly less visual prominence than a thicker ring, but it prevents confusion in dense layouts where rings might collide.

name: Reader
text: Risk: A 4px ring with 2px offset still risks failing 4.5:1 contrast on dark backgrounds. Better alternative: Use a 3px ring with 3px offset—it meets contrast on both light and dark themes. Settle it by testing the exact colors in WCAG’s contrast checker.
